description: Find a policy setting by the user's words: which fields of the policy it is, their current values (NOT_SET when the policy leaves a field out: it can still be set), where the portal's policy editor shows it (portalLocation) and how to change it. Policy reads leave unset fields out, so call this before saying a policy can't do something, that a setting doesn't exist, or where a setting is in the portal; name only the portalLocation it gives.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

policyId.description: The policy's path name - the unique identifier returned by list_policies as "pathName".

query.description: The setting in the user's own words, any language ("keyboard microphone", "volume fixo em 50%", "papel de parede", "block USB").

name: find_policy_setting
title: Find a policy setting
